notes_context:
These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0007] Refunds above 500.00 need approved_by: Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver per finance policy FIN-2026-03: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise BillingError("approval_required") when the amount exceeds the threshold and approved_by is missing; amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0008] Money-moving operations take idempotency_key: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. capture in ledgerly/payments.py) must accept a keyword-only `idempotency_key=None`. Check ledgerly.audit.events() for an existing entry with that key first, before validating state, and return the original result without reapplying; include idempotency_key in the audit.record call.
  (learned from task E06 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0004] Exclude bool when validating integer fields: When validating integer arguments in ledgerly, check isinstance(x, bool) first, since bool is a subclass of int and True would otherwise pass a positive-integer check.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 2x, 2 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0003] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors with the established codes such as "invalid_state" and "negative_amount", passing repr() of the offending value as detail.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 4x, 3 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0005] Normalize datetimes with ensure_utc: In ledgerly, normalize any incoming datetime with `ensure_utc` from `ledgerly.clock` before comparing or doing arithmetic (see `current_period` in `ledgerly/subscriptions.py`).
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0006] Compute periods via timedelta floor division: Compute subscription period indices with `(at - start) // timedelta(days=sub.period_days)` as `current_period` does, rather than dividing day counts manually.
  (learned from task E03 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)

item.title: Raise BillingError with code and detail
item.content: In ledgerly modules, reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) with a short snake_case code such as "non_positive_amount" or "invalid_state", not ValueError.
